system.description: Stout and sturdy folk who dwell in hills and mountains. Known for their craftsmanship, resilience, and fierce loyalty to clan and kin.
traits: Dwarven Resilience: Advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage.
Stonecunning: You have advantage on Investigation checks to notice unusual stonework.
Craftsmen: You gain a +1 bonus to Craft skill checks.
